comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and Morgan Stanley disclose specific lending exposures to distinct industrial sectors, though the sectors differ. Citi provides detailed credit exposure figures for the Auto ($17.5 billion) and Energy ($4.4 billion) sectors as part of its Corporate Credit portfolio mix. Morgan Stanley discloses lending against commercial real estate (CRE) properties totaling $10.7 billion within its Institutional Securities segment. Both disclosures serve to quantify risk concentration in specific real-economy sectors, but Citi's focus is on transportation and energy finance, whereas Morgan Stanley's highlighted metric is real estate lending.
